caption:
S&P cuts France's credit outlook to negative from stable

S&P Global Ratings made the change on Friday, ahead of elections in France. Weak economic growth and higher interest costs add to budget pressure, S&P says. France's public debt is mounting.

Reported by Financial Times; Bloomberg; France 24; The Wall Street Journal.
